title: Objectives 3 / Backup the settings
body:
I am a bit frustrated. I've been able to answer all the other objectives without help, and on the supposedly easiest question, I keep failing.  Is there a bug? 

I've just the german version. 

It's about the backup the settings. 1. Export settings after first setup and preferences. 2. Dont need to backup, if it's all write down on paper 3. Export settings after finishing the objectives 4. Export settings after every change of setting. 

I would say: 1. yes / 2. no / 3. yes / 4. yes
